content: Ma ta hanapugeya naka geka hipulina kapena ta mimiyeya ina gunagoluhi apo Yaubada uyahina numa ta waya. Naka numana hoi yada ega lawa nimahiyei hita wogoya ma apo ina mae po ina nae houga ega a siga.
Geka hougana to gabagabala ma i luhogala to pa hilaki i ani mae hoi yada u hinena tota lui.
I luhogala ipa naka ani maena to luiluiya mei anai kalekoiyai ma ega a hinikwakwawiyai.

Geka kapena u hinena to memae naka to gabagabala babana to nugowitai. Ega ipa geka hipulina ani maena to hopu haleya ma nugonugoiyai ipa ani mae yadei to luiya po luyagohanagei geka hiniyeina budabudana ina liyababaya.
Yaubada tauna geka ginoulina uyahina i wononogogeta po Alugona Woiyawa i weleta mei ani wiwawala. Ma apoma apo awai gehouhi ubeita i wononogogehi muliyei ina weleta.
Uyahinei houga magomagouna nugonugoiyai he kadikadidili. To hanapugeya geka hiniyeihi uyahihi to meme nugotau naka ega Guyau a numa.
Yaka ega galenagei tota nenae ma witumaganagei to nenae.
Ma nugonugoiyai i kadidili po to luhogaleya ipa geka hiniyeihi to nehalehi po to nae Guyau mitehi to mae.
Ma amaka tauna uyahina to geleta bo yohola i wileta baneina ipa tauna to laikaohaya.

Matababana ataputa apo Keliso u matana ta towolo pahita po tauna ina luhetaleta. Lawa emosi po emosi awai hinina uyahina i dewadewaya apo mihana ina witagoya. Dewadewa yaka mihana dewadewa ma apapoe yaka mihana apapoe.
Keliso tepanei Yaubada mitehi ta witulana
Yaubada matoutana to hanapugeya yaka to ileta ipa lawa gehouhi nugonugohi ipa to winihi. Ma Yaubada i hanapugena pahiyai po gasi nugote taumi amaka nugonugomiyei o hanapugeiyai.

Ega ipa to witowolo mena meiyai u matami ma ipa iyowai apo ona nugonugogegeiyai a matababana to paliwelemi. Yaka iyawoi nawa hai ani bagibagi he nugonugogegeya ma ega nugonugona hinena geka tauhi lawahi apo hai baha ona wimihehi.
Inapa to buuwa yaka naka Yaubada binei ma to buuwa. Ma inapa ununuiyai a dumadumaluhi yaka naka taumi bimiyei ununuiyai hi dumalu.
Keliso luhogalana e tanitaniwageiyai babana to hanapugeya naka tauna tunawana lawa ataputa ubeita i hilage. Uyahinei tauta gasi ataputa ta hilage.
Ma ataputa ubeita i hilahilage binei tauta iyawoi ta lauyagohana ega ipa tunawata bitiyei ta wobagibagi ma ipa Keliso binei ta wobagibagi. Matababana tauna ubeita i hilage po i towolo meme.
Uyahinei geka hougana lawa apega to winimayoyougehi hipuli winugonugotuhuna uyahina. Moina lolowa Keliso geka pite to nugotuhuniyeya ma geka hougana eega.
Hougana lawa ina wiemota Keliso uyahina naka tauna lawa wouna. Ginouli odubohi amaka hi kokoe ma ginouli atapuhi hi gunabuinihi po mei wouhi.

Geka ginoulihi atapuhi naka Yaubada i dewahi. Tauna lolowa a gawiya tauta ma Keliso uyahinei i buinita po tauta a lawa. Ma lawa gehouhi ta dewahi po tauna mitehi hina itulana naka bagibagina i weleiyai.
Ata tuwega naka tu mehipuli ataputa Keliso uyahinei ma Yaubada i witulaneta po ega ata apapoe ita hiyahiyawihi. Ma iyowai apo lawa to dewahi po ina itulanehi naka wituwetuwegana bagibagina i weliyai.
Yaka tauyai Keliso binei to ibaabani. Amaka mei Yaubada tauna ina laupali tiyai gamoiyei. Ma tauyai Keliso binei to laupaliyemi to pa, ‘Yaubada ona lupaliyeya po ina witulanemi.’
Matababana Keliso ega a apapoe ma tauta bitiyei ma Yaubada i dewaya po ata apapoe atapuhi i awala gogonihi. Geka pite i dewaya ipa tana iemota Keliso mitehi apo Yaubada a dewadumalu ta wialoni.
